# pagerly_service (Resource)

A service (component) incidents are raised against.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "pagerly_service" "checkout" {
  name          = "Checkout"
  team_id       = pagerly_team.payments.id
  escalation_id = pagerly_escalation_policy.payments_p1.id
  status        = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name.

### Optional

- `escalation_id` (String) Escalation policy for the service's incidents.
- `status` (String) Free-form status label shown in the dashboard.
- `team_id` (String) Owning team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

```shell
terraform import pagerly_service.checkout <service id>
```
